ps1_scoped.exact_try_hypothesis: TRY-HYPOTHESIS: prioritise exploring the hampel family (hampel_filter) among the candidates you propose. This is a ranking suggestion only and is not execution authority: it supplies one candidate for the same candidate budget and grants no right to deploy.

h0_instruction_md_lines_1_6: You are the TTHA preparation Agent. Use only public observations, declared tools,
canonical operator contracts, retrieved Harness content, and the typed output schema.
Never request or infer clean references, injection metadata, candidate utility, or
private rankings. Inspect before proposing. Supply at most the configured number of
effect-distinct PROGRAM candidates. Select exactly one candidate, including identity.
Keep modifications local and abstain when public evidence does not justify a repair.

quotes.1_goal: From the current TaskContext, the public Pattern evidence, and any retrieved Experience, construct minimal, effect-distinct typed PROGRAM candidates whose expected effects can be verified on the current Context.
quotes.2_inspect_inputs: At the inspect stage only the deployment-visible feature summary and the public tools are available.
quotes.2_propose_inputs: At the propose stage the inspection payload (inspected region fractions, uncertainty, and structured pattern hypotheses), the allowed operator contracts, the fixed probe panel, and any retrieved positive, negative, or conflict Experience are additionally available.
quotes.4b_runtime_prior: The Source prior, when admissible, is injected by the runtime into a pool slot; do not propose a copy of it.
quotes.4f_experience_slot: Retrieved Experience may inform the prior slot but must never remove the exploration slot.
quotes.propose_rule_effect_distinct: do not propose operators merely because they are allowed.
quotes.propose_rule_no_legal_binding: When no legal binding exists for a hypothesis, abstain by returning an empty candidate set rather than an unverifiable program.

proposal_instruction_audit.bootstrap_inspect_and_localize: Inspect public missingness, robust local deviation, level continuity, and period-consistency evidence, and localize regions. ... (no skill-card / operator-family instruction)
proposal_instruction_audit.bootstrap_select: Compare candidates using deployment-visible evidence and risk guards only; choose one ID explicitly and record verification actions and scope.
proposal_instruction_audit.tension: instruction.md names retrieved Harness content as a legal input. Clause 4b tells the agent the prior is runtime-injected and not to copy it. PS-1 TRY-HYPOTHESIS says the card 'supplies one candidate' but the runtime never injects one. The model is licensed to read the card and simultaneously told not to copy a runtime prior that never arrives.
